Problem 2 · Guests who drift away

Four decisions the guest list answers

Who are our regulars?
Thank them by name. Give them first look at a new special.
Who has not been back in 30 days?
Send a win-back offer to that list only.
Which night brings new sign-ups?
Put the promotion money behind that night.
Which reward brings guests back?
Change the reward each quarter. Compare return visits.
